concept: Sunny roadside-diner morning: butter-yellow sunshine and buttermilk cream grounded by deep denim-blue booths, with a maple-toast secondary — bright Route 34 daylight with a blue-plate-special heart, deliberately distinct from the amber/orange breakfast palettes in the fleet.
